narr: Clusters of thunderstorms with very high rainfall rates from 2 to 4 inches per hour developed during the overnight hours June 20-21. The primary focus occurred near and just north of Interstate 90. The final 24 hour rainfall totals reached 4 to 8 inches by daybreak across Rock County and nearby areas.
ev: Heavy rainfall from 5 to 8 inches in the later evening and overnight hours brought widespread flooding to roads in areas to the east and south of Luverne. One water rescue occurred along Interstate 90 near mile marker 17 when a semi-truck tipped over in the ditch and was mostly covered by water. Interstate 90 was closed near Magnolia for several hours with water flowing over the roadway. The river gage near Hardwick on the Rock River reached flood stage at 2 am CST after three hours of heavy rainfall in the area. For a more comprehensive description of flood damage, please see other entries for areal and river flooding for Rock County.
lsr: River gage HRDM5 over flood stage after 3 to 4 inches of rain in a couple hours.
